comparison.objective: Candidate mounts one rack rail; record matches caps to four pens and sorts the completed pens by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs structural alignment, latching, extension, and tool use; record repeats small-part cap insertion and classification-based placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks mechanical retention and prescribed fastening; record awards per matching retained cap and correctly released pen in a bounded area.
comparison.reason: Cap fitting and color sorting do not test the candidate's staged load-bearing installation. Candidate numeric engagement and release-clearance thresholds remain incomplete.
